title: A rapid and highly-sensitive surface plasmon resonance \(SPR)-based immunoassay procedure for human fetuin A
protocol: Incubate the Au-coated SPR chip with 90 µL of 1% (w/v) KOH for 5 min.
Wash the SPR chip extensively with DIW.
Mix capture anti-HFA antibody (200 µg mL\(^{-1}\)) with 1% APTES in a 1:1 volume ratio.
Dispense 90 µL of the mixed solution onto the Au chip, achieving a final concentration of 100 µg mL\(^{-1}\) in 0.5% APTES.
Incubate the mixture on the Au chip for 30 min at room temperature in the fume hood.
Wash the anti-HFA antibody-bound Au SPR chip extensively with 10 mM HBS, pH 7.4.
Dock the anti-HFA antibody-bound Au SPR chip into Biacore 3000 and prime it.
Inject 20 µL of 1% (w/v) BSA over all four flow cells of the anti-HFA antibody-bound Au SPR chip at a flow rate of 10 µL min\(^{-1}\).
Filter BSA or filter the BSA solution prior to use to remove any microbial or other contaminants.
Pass fifty microliters of running buffer through all flow cells before HFA capture.
Record changes in SPR response units (RU) corresponding to blanks.
Pass fifty microliters of HFA at seven different concentrations (0.3, 0.6, 1.2, 2.5, 5.0, 10.0, and 20.0 ng/mL) through the flow cells of an Ab-bound SPR chip in consecutive cycles.
Regenerate the Ab-bound SPR chip surface after each analysis by treating it with 10 mM glycine-HCl, pH 2.0.
Subtract RU values obtained for blanks from the RU values for HFA detected in respective flow cells.
Plot SPR-based HFA detection curves using SigmaPlot software version 11.2.
Generate analytical parameters such as EC50 and Hillslope using standard curve analysis based on a four parameter logistic function.
